title: IELTS Academic 21 - Listening Test 1 - Part 2
transcriptHtml:
LISTENING TRANSCRIPT - PART 2

💡 Audio-Track Sync: Bấm vào bất kỳ câu nào dưới đây để phát audio ngay đúng câu đó!

08:57MAN: Hello and welcome to the film making podcast. In this week's episode, Claire Lamar talks to us about how to become a makeup artist...
09:17WOMAN: Thanks, Ian. Well, before you can become a makeup artist on films, you have to spend about 2 years working as a makeup trainee.
09:30A good place to get your first job would be on a low-budget short film. Of course, this means that you'll be working for free, but it's often worth it for the experience.
09:41Make sure your transport costs are covered - and remember, there's very unlikely to be any catering provided, so bring plenty of food.
09:49If you're lucky, you might start out on a big budget film where you'll get the most useful experience...
10:02But you're likely to get the opportunity to work with a range of age groups as well as different ethnicities.
10:24One problem with working in the makeup department is that it's a high pressure environment... It can be stressful, but you'll see that the top makeup artists are very professional, even when they're having to work with directors who are impatient.
10:56I've worked with many very famous actors over the years. At first, I found it overwhelming and could hardly speak. I was so in awe.
11:18Every makeup trainee will need a makeup kit, which they'll be expected to have with them at all times. Just the essentials will do for the kinds of tasks you'll be given.
11:45But remember, you'll need to get approval from the makeup designer in charge of the department as you'll be sending your portfolio digitally.
12:49So what does a makeup trainee actually do?
13:02You may be asked to help prep an actor ready for makeup... step in and get this done without wasting any time. Otherwise, the makeup artist will get behind schedule.
13:23Trainees play a useful role in continuity... This information needs to be kept in good order, as a re-shoot can mean replicating makeup months later.
13:47General duties mean doing anything from getting the teas and coffees to putting on a wash. Having a positive attitude and being willing to do whatever is asked of you.
14:04If there are dozens of extras involved, you'll need to keep up a swift pace and not spend too long on each person.
questionHtml:
Questions 11-16

Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

11. What should trainees always expect to get when working on low budget short films?

• Đáp án đúng: A
• Dấu hiệu: 'transport costs are covered' = travel expenses.

12. According to the speaker, on big budget films trainees may get experience of

• Đáp án đúng: B
• Dấu hiệu: 'different ethnicities'.

13. The speaker says a problem for makeup artists is

• Đáp án đúng: A
• Dấu hiệu: 'directors who are impatient'.

14. How did the speaker feel when she met famous actors for the first time?

• Đáp án đúng: A
• Dấu hiệu: 'could hardly speak. I was so in awe' = very shy.

15. What advice does the speaker give about makeup kits?

• Đáp án đúng: A
• Dấu hiệu: 'have with them at all times. Just the essentials will do'.

16. What advice does the speaker give about creating a portfolio?

• Đáp án đúng: C
• Dấu hiệu: 'get approval from the makeup designer'.

Questions 17-20

What ability is required for each duty? Choose A, B, or C.

Abilities:
A. being well-organised | B. being flexible | C. working quickly

17. Prepping an actor

Đáp án đúng: C (without wasting any time).

18. Continuity

Đáp án đúng: A (kept in good order).

19. General

Đáp án đúng: B (willing to do whatever).

20. Applying makeup

Đáp án đúng: C (swift pace, not spend too long).
